evals.name: all-authors
evals.prompt: Add AllAuthors to the projected Library author model.
evals.expected_output: A public static query on the author record.
assertions: Places Author in Authors/Author.cs with AuthorId and Name.

evals.name: mongo-dependency
evals.prompt: What packages, imports and host setup make the AllAuthors method compile and resolve its collection?
assertions: Injects IMongoCollection<Author> rather than accepting it as a client argument.

evals.name: second-delivery
evals.prompt: Distinguish an observable author list from a one-time author list.
assertions: Registers an author while the subscription is open.
Checks the new ID and name without reconnecting.
